shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing an armchair near the bookcase end. A man in a yellow shirt sits in the doorway-side sofa seat recounting dance partners from the ball, while a woman in a purple shirt sits in the bookcase-side sofa seat and a woman in a red shirt sits in the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt leaves her seat and exits the venue. The man in a yellow shirt asks if the full recap of the dance can still be finished.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two sofa seats.

shots.content: The man in a yellow shirt explains why the evening ball was a success.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the coffee-table side, centered on the person at the doorway-side sofa seat.

shots.content: The man in a yellow shirt lists the remaining dances from the evening.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the coffee table.
